skills.role: Entry command. Starts or resumes a post-production project. Invoked as /creative-studio-post:post.
First-run setup: checks the tools this computer needs, asks, installs them and checks again; says how to connect AgentC.
Creates a project.json from a Drive folder + pre-prod release package path + project id.
Resumes a stalled project by reading state + artefacts on disk.
Catalogs footage + audio from the Drive folder, writes manifest.json with checksums.
Frame-matches storyboard against manifest, emits rough EDL.
Shortlists three BGM candidates locally from the supplied tracks (no MCP tool); the person picks one on the board.
Places VO tracks on timeline against script markers.
Runs the local ffmpeg sync (no MCP tool). Emits synced-track.json + waveform.png.
Handles a single B-roll request, quoted on the board, via create_video_job on AgentC. Saves to bundle/broll/.
Builds an infographic or motion-graphic alpha via Remotion, saves to bundle/mograph/.
Runs scripts/build-bundle.js (local; no MCP tool). Emits project.fcpxml + bundle/ tree.
Publishes this account's own Post Control board artifact (db, artifact, comments) and records its address.
Keeps the Post Control board and the job folder agreeing: push batches, land decisions, hash-bound gate pull.
Runs a rubric against a gate. Emits review.md verdict.
Generated jobs only: one AI clip per storyboard panel via AgentC create_video_job, sample then batch, every credit approved on the board; lands under footage/generated.
Hybrid jobs: briefs plates, locations and backgrounds (hybrid.js), cuts the actor out of every plate (cutout.py): chroma key or rembg.
Hybrid jobs, moving-camera plates: motion transfer on AgentC (plate as [Video 1], background as [Image 1]); the plate's actor is pasted back by composite.
Hybrid jobs: backgrounds per location (library, or AgentC create_image_job after a yes), composite.py lays the actor over them and checks the performance is kept.
